verdict.rationale: Kong provides decK for exporting declarative configuration (open YAML/JSON) and Insomnia supports exporting collections/specs (OpenAPI, Postman, HAR) and design documents for version control, which supports data portability in open formats. However, there is no evidence of a single comprehensive 'export all data' function covering Gateway runtime data, Konnect platform data, analytics, or full account data in one open-format bundle. missing for 10: consolidated full-data export across Gateway/Konnect/analytics, explicit data-portability/GDPR-style export guarantee, independent confirmation of completeness of exported data.
